damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The marilith's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.description: The marilith can take one reaction on every turn in combat.

traits.name: Teleport
traits.description: The marilith magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Parry
traits.description: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the marilith must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

multiattack_text: The marilith can make seven attacks: six with its longswords and one with its tail.

attacks.name: Longsword
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

attacks.name: Tail
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 19). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, the marilith can automatically hit the target with its tail, and the marilith can't make tail attacks against other targets.
